rationale: Synthetic long-form proposal used to verify that Memory Inbox cards, status labels, semantic findings, and review actions remain readable without overlapping at desktop, laptop, tablet, and compact widths.
evidence: No external account, credential, customer data, or live Figma document was used.
The English evidence text intentionally remains unchanged when the Atlas interface switches to Spanish.

items.title: Keep critical decision copy readable when translated labels become substantially longer
items.summary: Decision controls wrap into a stable vertical rhythm, preserve their complete explanation, and never shrink checkboxes, radio buttons, priorities, or state labels into accidental vertical text.

items.title: Store one semantic memory proposal with localized Atlas findings
items.summary: Atlas-authored findings may render by semantic key in English or Spanish, while user-authored rationale, canonical memory, file names, and indexed evidence retain their original language and provenance.

items.title: Long proposal rationale and summary content can expose inherited grid constraints
items.summary: A proposal article must own its content layout instead of inheriting a three-column catalog-row grid, because additional metadata, headings, summaries, replacement identifiers, and findings otherwise overlap.
